criteria.id: a caller reads a canvas of stages and steps for a template
editing a draft canvas node updates the template step and reports invalid nodes
builtin templates cannot be overwritten on the canvas
validate reports a missing dependency before publish
Test Lab dry-runs happy-path, missing-approval, resource-conflict, stale-state, and missing-evidence
publish is blocked until a passing happy-path test run exists
customers cannot edit the canvas or run the Test Lab
